arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import parse

# Test left-aligned search with width
r = parse.search('{:<5}', 'hello       world')
print('Left-align search w/width:', r.fixed if r else None)

# Test center-aligned search with width  
r2 = parse.search('{:^5}', 'hello     world')
print('Center-align search w/width:', r2.fixed if r2 else None)

# What about just right-align?
r3 = parse.search('{:>5}', 'hello       world')
print('Right-align search w/width:', r3.fixed if r3 else None)
" 2>&1 | grep -v SyntaxWarning
